title: Quiz: Subquery Patterns
description: Check your understanding of Subquery Patterns.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in SQL?
questions.explanation: In SQL, -- marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What does IN do with a subquery?
questions.correctAnswer: Checks membership against the subquery result set

questions.question: True or False: x IN (subquery) is true when x appears in those rows.
What is the main purpose of the Subquery Patterns technique shown in this lesson?
questions.explanation: It exists to help you subquery patterns effectively.

questions.question: In SQL, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
